title: Debating the Fundamental Truths of  32-Inch Wheels
content:
On the Velo Podcast, we brought on two bike industry experts who have dramatically different opinions on 32-inch wheels. It was an important step, not just for the podcast, but for the industry’s understanding of what is fastest.

Read the full article at Debating the Fundamental Truths of 32-Inch Wheels on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
